text: كيفك اليوم؟ وين رايح بعد الشغل؟
expected: How are you today? Where are you going after work?

text: بدي كاسة شاي مع سكر خفيف لو سمحت.
expected: I want a cup of tea with light sugar, please.

text: صحيت اليوم على صوت التلفون وهوا برن.
expected: I woke up today to the sound of the phone ringing.
known_bad: I'm healthy today with the phone call and playing.

text: قاعد بحكي معك من الصبح ومش معبرني، شو القصة؟
expected: I have been talking to you all morning and you are ignoring me, what is going on?
known_bad: Stay with me from morning until night, what's the story?

text: يلا فكك من هالسولافة وخلينا نمشي بدري عشان الزحمة.
expected: Come on, drop this topic and let us leave early because of the traffic.
known_bad: Let's break this down and let's walk around because there's a crowd.

text: الشب مقطوع من شجرة وعم بحرث على حاله حرث ليدبر حاله.
expected: The young man has no family support and is working relentlessly to make ends meet.
known_bad: The wire is cut from a tree, and the farmer is busy harvesting as he plans his day.

text: طول بالك علي، لا تطير في العجة وتعمل قصة من ولا اشي.
expected: Be patient with me, do not jump to conclusions and make a big deal out of nothing.
known_bad: You're being too harsh, don't fly in the sky, don't make up stories, don't do anything.

text: السلام عليكم، وش أخبارك اليوم عساك طيب؟
expected: Peace be upon you, how are you today, hope you are doing well?

text: وين طالع الحين في هالقايلة؟
expected: Where are you going right now in this scorching midday heat?
known_bad: Where can I find the next time I need to go?

text: أبشرك خلصنا كل المعاملات بدري والسيارة جاهزة.
expected: Good news: we finished all the paperwork early and the car is ready.

text: ما عليك منه، هذا بس يتفلسف وما يدري وين ربي حاطه.
expected: Do not worry about him, he is just acting smart and has no clue what he is talking about.
known_bad: You don't need to do anything, it's just a fantasy, and he doesn't know what he's talking about.

text: والله ما هقيتها منك، طيحت وجهي قدام الرجال وأنا اللي عازمهم.
expected: I really did not expect this from you, you embarrassed me in front of the men when I was their host.
known_bad: And God forbid that I should have done such a thing, I slapped my face in front of the men and I was the one who was determined to shame them.

text: تكفى لا تبطي علينا، ترانا على أحر من الجمر ونحتريك.
expected: Please do not be late on us, we are waiting eagerly for you.
known_bad: It's enough; don't bother us, we're better off than you and we're not afraid.

text: إزيك يا باشا، عامل إيه في الشغل الجديد؟
expected: How are you chief, how are you doing in the new job?

text: أنا رايح مشوار على السريع وراجع علطول.
expected: I am going on a quick errand and coming right back.

text: النهاردة الدنيا زحمة موت في كوبري أكتوبر ومفيش عربية بتتحرك.
expected: Today traffic is deadly crowded on 6th October bridge and not a single car is moving.
known_bad: Today is very busy with traffic on the Cairo Bridge and no Arabs are moving.

text: روق دمك كدة وفكها شوية، متحبكهاش أوي الموضوع مش مستاهل.
expected: Chill out and relax a bit, do not overcomplicate it, the matter is not worth it.
known_bad: Your blood pressure is high, and you're having a seizure. Your girlfriend doesn't love you. This is not a good situation.

text: يا عم سيبك منه، ده بيبيع الميّة في حارة السقايين.
expected: Man, ignore him, he is trying to sell water in the water-sellers' alley.
known_bad: Bro, don't worry about it. That's just selling fake news in the Scaia neighborhood.

text: الراجل ده عينه زايغة وكل شوية يعمل حوارات ومشاكل ملهاش لازمة.
expected: That man has a wandering eye and constantly stirs up unnecessary drama and trouble.
known_bad: The man has a red eye, and he always has conversations and problems that he can't handle.

text: شلونك عيوني؟ أني هسه طالع من الدوام وجاي عليك بالطريق.
expected: How are you my dear? I am just leaving work right now and on my way to you.
known_bad: What's wrong with your eyes? I can't see anything from work time, and I'm coming to meet you on the way.

text: لا تلح بالموضوع زايد تره السالفة عويصة وما تنحل هيج.
expected: Do not push the matter too much, the situation is complicated and cannot be solved like this.
known_bad: don't bring up the subject of Zaid, he's already drunk, and don't bring it up again.
